description: Innercise Yoga at the Georgian Terrace Hotel
long_description:
Innercise Yoga at the Georgian Terrace Hotel

About this Event

What's better than yoga in the middle of the most beautiful hotel in the city? This time, wear your costume!
The Georgian Terrace is a modern luxury hotel with sophisticated decor, that is rich in history. Their outdoor terrace is a fabulous space to find tranquility in the middle of the city and their lobby has the one of the oldest existing murals in Atlanta. W'ell decide closer to time where we will have class (weather depending). Let's get spiritual and stretch with the option to stay and enjoy 1 complimentary cocktail or mocktail of choice after class. There are also two restaurants on site for dinner: Livingston and Edgar's Proof & Provision. Bring your own yoga mat and let's Innercise!
